description: This file contains an abstract test class for verifying implementations of the SignalEnrichmentFacade interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.signalenrichment package. It includes several test cases to validate behaviour such as successful retrieval, handling of exceptions, timeouts, and relevant event processing.

classes.name: AbstractSignalEnrichmentFacadeTest
classes.description: An abstract test class providing common test cases for implementations of the SignalEnrichmentFacade interface.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Tests the successful retrieval of partial thing data via the facade and verifies the returned JSON matches expectations.

methods.name: thingNotAccessible
methods.description: Tests how the facade handles a situation where the thing is not accessible, expecting a specific exception.

methods.name: unexpectedMessage
methods.description: Tests the behavior when an unexpected message is received from the command handler, expecting a runtime exception.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Verifies that a timeout during the retrieve operation results in an AskTimeoutException.

methods.name: dontEnrichThingDeleted
methods.description: Verifies that no retrieval is attempted when a ThingDeleted event is processed for enrichment.

methods.name: createSignalEnrichmentFacadeUnderTest
methods.description: Abstract factory method to instantiate the facade implementation for testing, given a TestKit and Duration.
